question.text: Which of the following risk management measures is applied at the trading system level in derivatives?

answer.text: Operating ranges and day minimum/maximum ranges that prevent erroneous order entry by causing a price freeze
Collection of initial margin from clients
Settlement guarantee by the clearing corporation
Mark-to-market settlement at end of day

explanation.text: The Logic: At the trading system level, the workbook (page 132) notes that no price bands are applicable to F&O contracts, but operating ranges and day minimum/maximum ranges are in place. When an order is entered outside these ranges, it triggers a price freeze, preventing erroneous orders from going through to the order book. The Trap: Initial margin collection, mark-to-market settlement and the settlement guarantee are clearing/settlement-level risk measures handled by the clearing corporation (workbook pages 159-161), not trading-system-level controls. Note: Trading-system-level controls focus on order entry; clearing-level controls focus on margining, MTM and counterparty risk.
